CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFGRID

CFGRID shows rows and columns of data inside a CFFORM, filled from a query or from CFGRIDROW tags. In browse mode cells can link to another page; in edit mode users can change, add and delete rows, and CFGRIDUPDATE writes the changes to the database. The 1999 grid was a Java applet; KoldFusion draws an HTML table in the applet's gray livery.

Category

Forms

Syntax

<CFGRID NAME="name"
    QUERY="query_name"
    SELECTMODE="mode"
    INSERT="Yes/No"
    DELETE="Yes/No"
    HREF="URL"
    HREFKEY="column_name"
    APPENDKEY="Yes/No"
    TARGET="window_name"
    FONT="font_name"
    WIDTH="width"
    HEIGHT="pixels"
    MAXROWS="number"
    SORT="Yes/No"
    BGCOLOR="color"
    NOTSUPPORTED="text">
  CFGRIDCOLUMN and CFGRIDROW tags
</CFGRID>

Attributes

NAME
Required. Name of the grid; the form fields it submits start with this name.
QUERY
Optional. Query that fills the grid. Without it, use CFGRIDROW tags.
SELECTMODE
Optional, default "BROWSE". BROWSE shows data (and links); EDIT turns cells into text fields for use with CFGRIDUPDATE; SINGLE and ROW put a radio button in each cell; COLUMN is accepted and shows plain data.
INSERT
Optional, default "No". EDIT mode: Yes adds an empty row for a new record.
DELETE
Optional, default "No". EDIT mode: Yes adds a "Del" check box to every row.
HREF
Optional. URL each cell links to (BROWSE mode). CFGRIDCOLUMN can override it per column.
HREFKEY
Optional. Column whose value is passed to the HREF page. Defaults to the value of the clicked cell.
APPENDKEY
Optional, default "Yes". Yes appends CFGRIDKEY=value to the HREF URL.
TARGET
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
FONT
Optional, default "Arial". Font face of the grid.
WIDTH
Optional, default "100%". Width of the grid table.
HEIGHT
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it (the table grows to fit).
MAXROWS
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it. Limit the query with MAXROWS instead.
SORT
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it. Sort with ORDER BY.
BGCOLOR
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
NOTSUPPORTED
Optional. Text for browsers without Java. No longer needed; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

Without CFGRIDCOLUMN tags, every query column is shown with its name as the header. With them, only the listed columns appear, in your order.

The many applet appearance attributes of 1999 (FONTSIZE, ITALIC, BOLD, TEXTCOLOR, GRIDLINES, ROWHEIGHT, COLHEADERS, PICTUREBAR, the button labels and so on) are accepted for compatibility and ignored.

In BROWSE mode with HREF, clicking a cell opens the HREF page with URL.CFGRIDKEY set to the key. In SINGLE and ROW mode each column gets its own group of radio buttons, submitted as form fields named gridname.columnname; read them with StructFind(Form, "gridname.columnname").

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFPARAM NAME="URL.CFGRIDKEY" DEFAULT="">

<CFIF IsNumeric(URL.CFGRIDKEY)>
  <CFQUERY NAME="GetOne" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
  SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email, StartDate
  FROM Employees WHERE Emp_ID = #Val(URL.CFGRIDKEY)#
  </CFQUERY>
  <CFOUTPUT QUERY="GetOne">
  <P><B>#FirstName# #LastName#</B> (#Email#) joined us on
  #DateFormat(StartDate, "mmmm d, yyyy")#.</P>
  </CFOUTPUT>
</CFIF>

<CFQUERY NAME="GetEmps" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets" MAXROWS="8">
SELECT Emp_ID, LastName, FirstName, Department, Phone
FROM Employees ORDER BY LastName
</CFQUERY>

<P>Click a name for details:
<CFFORM NAME="Staff" ACTION="cfgrid.cfm">
<CFGRID NAME="EmpGrid" QUERY="GetEmps" WIDTH="460" FONT="Verdana"
    HREF="cfgrid.cfm" HREFKEY="Emp_ID">
  <CFGRIDCOLUMN NAME="LastName" HEADER="Last name">
  <CFGRIDCOLUMN NAME="FirstName" HEADER="First name">
  <CFGRIDCOLUMN NAME="Department" HEADER="Department">
  <CFGRIDCOLUMN NAME="Phone" HEADER="Phone">
</CFGRID>
</CFFORM>
